answer: Require each agent to stake a bond slashed on proven duplicate behavior, and tie reputation to a costly work history rather than free account creation. Like bees returning to one hive for nectar, an agent must prove useful service before its votes count, so a Sybil farmer faces expense for every fake identity. Rate-limit new entrants with a velvet-smooth onboarding terrace: small permissions first, larger rights only after sustained, verifiable contributions and peer attestation. Cloning identities then costs more than the influence gained, so honest agents keep the advantage.
